🎵 Lidarr

Connect to your Lidarr instance to add artists and track downloads.

e.g. http://10.0.0.244:8686

Find in Lidarr: Settings → General → API Key

Which Lidarr quality profile to use for new artists

Where new artists are stored. Folders auto-discovered from Lidarr.

📊 Last.fm

Used to get popularity scores for tracks and albums.

Get one at https://www.last.fm/api/account/create

🎯 General

60

Albums/tracks with avg popularity at or above this score are added. Higher = stricter.

⏰ Schedule

When to run the daily check. Format: '0 9 * * *' = 9 AM daily.

💬 Discord (optional)

Enable a Discord bot for commands and daily reports. Leave token blank to disable.

From https://discord.com/developers/applications

Where daily reports are posted. Right-click channel in Discord → Copy ID.

Allow All Users

If off, only users in the allow-list can run commands

Auto-Thread on Mentions

Create a thread for each mention of the bot

Require Bot Mention

Only respond when the bot is @mentioned

Groovarr connects Lidarr with Deezer & Last.fm to automatically filter your music library to only the popular releases.

All settings are stored in SQLite. Database: /data/groovarr.db
